items.title: JK Urbanscapes to invest Rs 1,000 cr to build 6 hotels, plans Rs 4,500-cr housing projects
items.snippet: JK Urbanscapes Developers Ltd is embarking on an ambitious journey with a series of real estate projects that promise lucrative returns. The company aims to launch six hotels in various locations, including Kanpur and Mussoorie, while also working on a sprawling 90-acre township in Kanpur and a senior living initiative in Gurugram.

items.title: GTA VI: from W to Y, when a Miami Beach hotel lends its façade to Vice City
items.snippet: In Miami Beach, the W South Beach has become the "Y Hotel" of GTA VI, for $650,000 paid by Rockstar Games. The video game is emerging as a lever for place marketing for hoteliers.

items.title: Taj appoints Sandeep Raghav as Cluster Sales and Marketing Director for Maldives resorts
items.snippet: Sandeep Raghav has been appointed Cluster Director of Sales and Marketing for Taj Exotica Resort and Spa, Maldives, and Taj Coral Reef Resort and Spa, Maldives. In his new role, Raghav will lead sales, marketing and strategic business development initiatives across international markets, including India.

items.title: Kolkata Municipal Corporation’s conditional nod for reopening of hotels, guest houses in hospital zone
items.snippet: There are around 300 hotels-cum-guest houses in the hospital zone off E M Bypass that cater to the families of patients at six major private hospitals in the vicinity. A KMC buildings department official said the civic body gave unconditional permission to 13 of the guest houses in the vicinity.

items.title: India proposes free tourist e-Visas for ASEAN citizens
items.snippet: India has proposed waiving tourist e-Visa fees for citizens of all ASEAN member states as part of nine initiatives aimed at strengthening ties with Southeast Asian partners. The proposal, announced in Manila, reflects New Delhi’s broader efforts to make international travel more accessible, encourage tourism and promote people-to-people exchanges across the region.

items.title: India’s Recognition as Destination of the Year 2027 Is a Defining Opportunity for Inbound Tourism: Hotel Association of India
items.snippet: The Hotel Association of India (HAI) has hailed India being named Destination of the Year for 2027. HAI called it a significant development that will draw attention to India from around the world and strengthen the country’s position as a global tourism destination.

items.title: Anand Mahindra urges India to improve tourism experience
items.snippet: Mahindra Group Chairman Anand Mahindra has called on the Centre and state governments to strengthen India’s tourism infrastructure and visitor experience following the country’s selection as Travel + Leisure’s ‘Destination of the Year 2027’. He said the recognition should be viewed as an opportunity to strengthen the country’s tourism offering rather than simply a reason to celebrate.
